name: guardian naga
desc: Guardian Naga is a CR 10 celestial.

actions.name: celestial restoration
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies, it returns to life in [[/r 1d6#Days]] days and regains all its Hit Points unless @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDispelEvil] is cast on its remains.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two [[/item Bite]] attacks. It can replace any attack with a use of [[/item Poisonous Spittle]].

actions.name: poisonous spittle
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=r4plP8QiJxzFZZO7]], [[lookup @target.affects.labels.statblock activity=r4plP8QiJxzFZZO7]] the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=r4plP8QiJxzFZZO7]] feet. Failure: 31 (7d8) Poison damage, and the target has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] condition until the start of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]): At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplThaumaturg]{Thaumaturgy} 1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplClairvoyan]{Clairvoyance}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCureWounds]{Cure Wounds} (level 6 version), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFlameStrik]{Flame Strike} (level 6 version), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGeas000000]{Geas}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplTrueSeeing]{True Seeing}
